name: hgi_sm_xl2p_bdring_1018

job.purpose: x-load BD ring leaf with the PRE bypass words (x_fmt 3); successor of hgi_sm_xl2_bdring
job.structural_change: cl2p bdring = main's closed cl2 bdring (86.4 x 302.4, cl2f faces) + bypass word pins pq_lo/hi (256), pe_lo/hi (10), pvo_lo/hi on the S face (534 pins 6.2/um; N face stays the 532 quantiser pins), pin-registered on the same edge as qq/qe and selected after the pins (ps ? wp : wr) -- one 2:1 mux in front of the ring write, no new path from a pin

pin_regs.reason: OWNER RULE 19:50 met in RTL (rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_cl2.sv, x-load cl2 rewritten for this rule; +2 edges accepted by the coordinator): inputs land in flops (ring enable flops on r_wsel/wd, wr_lo/wr_hi quantiser words, bsa/bsb select replicas, lane_en copy); output bq_d is a register; a recipe-3 register would add a second stage on every port. cl2p: pq/pe/pvo land in wp_*/ps_* pin flops on the qq/qe edge.

floorplan_note: HBM-COLLQ/X 10-18 cl2p: S face carries the bypass words (the two bypass tiles sit S of the ring leaf); rest = cl2f.
